content.overview: Article 380 was a transitional provision concerning the President until election under Part V. Omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent; not living law.
content.glance: Art 380 omitted by 7th Amendment 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Transitional President provision — spent.
content.study: Part of the 379–391 transitional block. Omitted by 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Do not cite as living law.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Status of Article 380?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Omitted by the 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
